We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). We need to measure spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (expensive). But maybe we can infer from carbon NMR? Both are expensive. We need minimal cost. Perhaps we can get carbon NMR first; methyl carbons appear as signals around 10-30 ppm. Count them. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Then count distinct methyl carbon signals. However overlapping may be ambiguous. Could also use HSQC to correlate. But likely simple molecule.

We need to decide which tool to use. Probably carbon_nmr_spectra is enough. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
